result.topic_en: Euler argues that the acceleration of the deflected elastic lamina must be negative, derives the fourth-order partial differential equation $-\frac{ddy}{dt^2} = b^4 \frac{d^4y}{dx^4}$ for its vibration, and begins section X on the conditions for integrating it.
result.transcription:
456 DE MOTV VIBRATORIO

deorſum tendunt, non ſolum curuaturam in Y non
ſuſtinerent, ſed adeo ad extenſionem in directum
deducerent, ex quo manifeſtum eſt, accelerationem
illam $(\frac{ddy}{dt^2})$ neceſſario valorem negatiuum habere de-
bere, quod etiam ipſa rei natura manifeſto declarat,
nam dum lamina A F a ſtatu naturali digreditur,
eius motus certe non accelerabitur, ſed potius re-
tardabitur, quo obſeruato ſequentem aequationem
nanciſcimur:
$-\frac{K}{2bk}\int dx \int dx (\frac{ddy}{dt^2}) = Kcc(\frac{ddy}{dx^2})$; ſiue
$-\int dx \int dx (\frac{ddy}{dt^2}) = 2bkcc(\frac{ddy}{dx^2})$,
qui coefficiens poſtremus quum neceſſario ſit poſi-
tiuus, ponamus breuitatis gratia $2bkcc = b^4$, vt
habeamus hanc aequationem:
$-\int dx \int dx (\frac{ddy}{dt^2}) = b^4 (\frac{ddy}{dx^2})$
et quia in illa integratione ſola $x$ vt variabilis ſpe-
ctatur, ſumtis vtrinque differentialibus, habebimus
$-\int dx (\frac{ddy}{dt^2}) = b^4 (\frac{d^3y}{dx^3})$ ac denuo differentiando
$-(\frac{ddy}{dt^2}) = b^4 (\frac{d^4y}{dx^4})$, a cuius formulae ſatis con-
cinnae integratione tota ſolutio noſtri Problematis
pendet.

X. Hic igitur quaeritur, cuiusmodi functio ap-
plicata $y$ debeat eſſe binarum variabilium $x$ et $t$,
vt aequationi differentiali quarti ordinis, quam mo-
do elicuimus, ſatisfiat. Ante autem quam hoc ne-
gotium ſuſcipiamus, omnes conditiones perpendiſſe
iuuabit, quibus quadruplex integratio iſtius aequa-
tionis

items.quote:
Hic igitur quaeritur, cuiusmodi functio ap-
plicata $y$ debeat eſſe binarum variabilium $x$ et $t$,
vt aequationi differentiali quarti ordinis, quam mo-
do elicuimus, ſatisfiat.
items.english: Here, therefore, it is asked what kind of function of the two variables $x$ and $t$ the ordinate $y$ must be in order to satisfy the fourth-order differential equation just derived.

items.quote:
Ante autem quam hoc ne-
gotium ſuſcipiamus, omnes conditiones perpendiſſe
iuuabit, quibus quadruplex integratio iſtius aequa-
tionis
items.english: But before we undertake this task, it will help to have weighed all the conditions by which the fourfold integration of this equation [is to be determined]
